# Max Estates Limited

[More About Us](https://maxestates.in/about)

Max Estates is a leading Real Estate developer in Delhi NCR. Established in 2016, Max Estates aspires to build
sustainable commercial and residential developments in Delhi NCR, with a focus on well-being. Max Estates in its pursuit
of emerging as the most preferred brand in real estate in NCR is driven by our vision to enhance quality of life through
the spaces we create.

![](https://maxestates.in/wp-content/themes/max-estate/html/img/skip-loader.png)

## Philosophy

The well-being of all our stakeholders is at the core of our operating philosophy. Our focus on well-being permeates the entire process, from design to execution, and operations, leading to an unparalleled experience.

Guided by our philosophy of Work _Well_ and Live _Well_, we aspire to create differentiated working and living experiences, in the commercial and residential segments, respectively. We ensure this by moving beyond the conventional separation of work, life, and well-being, and paying attention to the entire spectrum of wellness across physical, emotional, social, and environmental aspects.

## Empathetic Hospitality

An intelligent approach to hospitality and service values empathy. We understand the emotional and social needs of our customers, and create spaces where they feel cared for.

## Environmental Harmony

We focus on holistic well-being, with immense attention paid to every element. Focus on elements like air, water and biophilia through interventions that aim to provide fresh air, water, and integrate green designs enable us to build developments that prioritise our users.

## Generosity

We believe in going beyond the required norm, to build generosity of time, space, and attention to detail into our spaces.

## Intentional Design

Our interventions are carefully to promote a healthier lifestyle, with the help of technology and design. We offer comfort with the right ergonomics, and thermal considerations. We integrate aesthetics with functionality, by including carefully curated artwork in our developments and encourage physical movement by building mobility into our spaces.

## Inclusivity

Our spaces are designed for the well-being of all in mind, irrespective of age, gender, ability and circumstances.

## Peace Of Mind

Our endeavor is to enable well-being for our users, in all ways possible. By carefully choosing well connected locations, opting for highest standards of sanitation and, and ensuring safety measures are in place, we build our users’ peace of mind into our developments.

## Belonging

Our developments promote social well-being by integrating amenities and events that promote engagement and interaction, leading to a true sense of community.

## Sustainability

Safeguarding the environment through energy and resource efficiency is the core principle of its sustainable development policy.

## Food and Nurtition

We care for the health and well-being of our customers by offering easy access to organic vegetables and biotic food sales. We also offer curated F&B options with focus on quality & nutrition.

## Customer Testimonials

As a company we firmly believe in our core offerings of Sevabhav, Excellence and Credibility, and leave no stone unturned in making our customers feel safe, secure and cared for in all of our spaces.

![](https://maxestates.in/wp-content/themes/max-estate/html/img/testimonial-img-1.jpg)

Max Towers is an obvious choice for any organization that believes in quality. And for us, it was very much the same story. Perhaps the cleanest air quality of any building in the NCR region, and great facilities that are demanded by a young and highly skilled workforce. It's the sort of building that makes you feel better about the place that you work, the moment you enter the building. And in some ways has an effect on your calmness, your motivation levels, and really pride it where you work. Location wise also, it's very convenient. All the key landmarks, particularly the high court, the supreme Court, places like Connaught Place, Bhikaji Kama, etc., are all very easily reachable, so it literally ticks all the boxes for us.

BHARAT ANAND

Partner, Khaitan & Co

![](https://maxestates.in/wp-content/themes/max-estate/html/img/testimonial-img-2.jpg)

So we already have moved in to the Max Towers building in October 2019. We are among the very first tenants of this building. When we chose to move here, we wanted obviously a place that reflects the value of the book, which is around sustainability. We were very first impressed by the vision Max showed in developing this project, and their care in terms of creating an environment where people work where together, and people live well together in a sustainable environment. Up to now, my group has absolutely lived to the standard, and we are extremely happy of our new office. The team, the operation team is extremely supportive, very active in any event or any issue. They deliver upon the promise are made to create a work well environment altogether.

GUILLAUME DOURDIN

CEO & Representative Director,
Veolia Japan
